description: Interop vectors for draft-atwood-mls-didwebvh-credential-00, generated by generate.mjs (Node built-in crypto only). did:webvh v1.0 is spec-v1.0 at decentralized-identity/didwebvh 91f3cba. Device keys are Ed25519; seed is the RFC 8032 private key.

reasons.webvh: fails a did:webvh v1.0 Read (Resolve) check
reasons.profile: fails a check of the draft's §did:webvh Profile or §The did:webvh Credential, though a plain did:webvh v1.0 resolver accepts it

logs.name: alice-v1
logs.note: genesis with pre-rotation committing to u2 and the recovery key

logs.name: alice-v2
logs.note: adds device d2, signed by a pre-rotated key

logs.name: alice-v3
logs.note: revokes device d2

logs.name: alice-v3b
logs.note: a fork of alice-v2 by the recovery key; valid on its own

logs.name: alice-v4b
logs.note: extends the alice-v3b fork

logs.name: bob-v1
logs.note: no pre-rotation

logs.name: bob-v2
logs.note: signed by the previous entry's update key

logs.name: carol-v1-witnessed
logs.note: threshold 2 of 3 met

logs.name: carol-v1-bad-proof-ignored
logs.note: §did:webvh Profile, Witnesses: "A witness proof that fails verification is ignored"

logs.name: carol-v1-extra-version-ignored
logs.note: §Log Verification item 4: "Proofs in witness_file for versionIds not in did_log are ignored"

logs.name: future-version-time
logs.note: §Log Verification item 3: "The verifier MUST NOT compare versionTime with its own clock"

logs.name: dave-authorized-keys
logs.note: §Conventions, "Authorized key": wrong controller, wrong type, unreferenced, unresolved, non-fragment relative and non-Ed25519 methods authorize nothing and do not invalidate the document

logs.name: tampered-entry
logs.note: state changed after signing: entryHash no longer matches

logs.name: wrong-signer
logs.note: a provider without an update key cannot authorize a device (§Provider-Issued Devices)

logs.name: uncommitted-update-key
logs.note: pre-rotation: the update key was not committed by the previous entry

logs.name: version-time-not-increasing
logs.note: §Log Verification item 3: strict increase still applies

logs.name: method-0.5
logs.note: §Log Verification item 2: method MUST be did:webvh:1.0

logs.name: deactivated-head
logs.note: §Log Verification item 5: the active deactivated MUST be false

logs.name: after-deactivation
logs.note: §Log Verification item 5: no entry may follow a deactivation

logs.name: witness-threshold-not-met
logs.note: one approval, threshold 2

logs.name: witness-bad-proof-not-counted
logs.note: §did:webvh Profile, Witnesses: only valid proofs count toward the threshold

logs.name: witness-file-missing
logs.note: witnesses active and witness_file empty

logs.name: no-final-lf
logs.note: §did:webvh Profile, Encoding: each line ends in LF

logs.name: crlf
logs.note: §did:webvh Profile, Encoding: a single LF

logs.name: blank-line
logs.note: §did:webvh Profile, Encoding: no blank lines

logs.name: fractional-version-time
logs.note: §did:webvh Profile, Encoding: versionTime is YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ

logs.name: offset-version-time
logs.note: §did:webvh Profile, Encoding: versionTime is YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ

logs.name: leading-zero-version
logs.note: §did:webvh Profile, Encoding: no leading zeros in the version number

logs.name: null-parameter
logs.note: §did:webvh Profile, Parameters: a null parameter MUST be rejected

logs.name: proof-not-array
logs.note: §did:webvh Profile, Proofs: an array containing exactly one proof

logs.name: two-proofs
logs.note: §did:webvh Profile, Proofs: exactly one proof

logs.name: duplicate-member
logs.note: §did:webvh Profile, Encoding: duplicate member names are rejected

logs.name: noncharacter
logs.note: RFC 7493 §2.1: no noncharacters

logs.name: percent-encoded-idn
logs.note: §did:webvh Profile, Domain: only ASCII letters, digits, hyphens and dots

logs.name: port-in-domain
logs.note: §did:webvh Profile, Domain (mimid reading, decision mimid-1wgh.4.81.12): %3A is not a letter, digit, hyphen or dot

logs.name: unexpected-witness-file
logs.note: §The did:webvh Credential: witness_file MUST be empty if no carried entry has active witnesses

logs.name: empty-log
logs.note: §The did:webvh Credential: did_log runs from the first entry through the head

binding.note: in the document but not in authentication

successor.note: §Successor Credentials: earlier log is a prefix

commits.name: first-device
commits.note: §Expected Heads: no reference entry, so L's head

commits.name: add-device-raises-head
commits.note: d1 keeps its older credential (§Successor Credentials, second paragraph)

commits.name: add-device-without-raising
commits.note: a Commit that changes the expected value must set it

commits.name: revocation-removes-device
commits.note: §Revoking a Device: the Commit carries alice-v3 and removes d2

commits.name: revocation-keeps-device
commits.note: §Rules, Authorization: the Commit that raises the head must remove d2

commits.name: stale-key-package
commits.note: §Withheld or Stale Logs: an old KeyPackage of the revoked d2

commits.name: record-outlives-devices
commits.note: §The Heads Extension: the record remembers the revocation after every device of the user has left

commits.name: older-credential-still-authorized
commits.note: §Successor Credentials: an older head stays valid while its key is recorded

commits.name: entry-never-removed
commits.note: §The Heads Extension: "an entry is never removed"

commits.name: entry-kept-without-leaves
commits.note: §Expected Heads: an SCID with no leaf keeps its entry unchanged

commits.name: fork-at-same-height
commits.note: §Rules, Consistency: a credential newer than R must be a prefix of L

commits.name: fork-against-record
commits.note: §Rules, Consistency: a credential at the recorded version must contain it

commits.name: newer-fork-lacks-reference
commits.note: §Expected Heads: L MUST contain R's versionId

commits.name: new-scid-two-forks
commits.note: no reference entry: every credential must be a prefix of L (mimid reading, decision mimid-1wgh.4.81.14)

joins.name: welcome-older-credential
joins.note: the joiner relies on the GroupContext for heads no leaf carries

joins.name: welcome-keys-mismatch
joins.note: a recorded head a leaf carries must list that document's keys
